events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks 80 years since the birth of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, in Zanzibar.

angles.name: A true icon
angles.copy: Eighty years since he was born, Freddie Mercury's incredible voice and flamboyant stage presence are still unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic lead singer, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her influence on rock music is undeniable. Which Pretenders hit is always on your playlist?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your top track from the iconic Mancunian?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK 55 years ago today.

angles.name: Timeless message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since its UK release, John Lennon's 'Imagine' album still resonates. What's your favourite lyric from this iconic record?

events.title: The first iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod, changing how we listen to music, 25 years ago today.

angles.name: Pocket full of tunes
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago, it put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed everything. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit screens, who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: A true visionary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedy is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today.

angles.name: A masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' remains a monumental and eclectic masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Forever a legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the world lost Freddie Mercury. His incredible legacy lives on through his music. What's your favourite Queen memory?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album, 'Rubber Soul', was released 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Evolution of sound
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since 'Rubber Soul' dropped, The Beatles truly pushed boundaries with this one. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon in New York City.

angles.name: A lasting legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's his most impactful song for you?
